pdp_text: The Streamline 4 returns with a refined silhouette and our smoothest ride yet. An engineered mesh upper is paired with a full-length AIRFOAM midsole for a plush underfoot feel. Whether you are chasing a personal best or just getting out the door, the Streamline 4 delivers premium comfort mile after mile. Available in black, white and blue colourways.
reviews: Really comfortable for daily runs, though they run a touch small.
Bought these for marathon training and they've held up well.
Feet stayed cooler than my old shoes.

pdp_text: All the comfort of the Streamline 4 in a roomier 2E fit. The same engineered mesh upper and AIRFOAM midsole, with additional volume through the forefoot. Innovative comfort for every foot shape.
reviews: Finally a shoe that doesn't crush my toes.
No blisters after 15km, which never happens for me.

pdp_text: Race day, redefined. A carbon fibre propulsion plate sits between two layers of nitrogen-infused foam to return energy with every stride. At just 186g, the Vapour Elite is our lightest racer ever. Tested by elite athletes across three continents.
reviews: Took 90 seconds off my 10K PB.
Amazing for racing but the foam packs out fast.
Not a shoe for slow miles.

pdp_text: Your everyday running companion. Soft cushioning, a durable rubber outsole and a breathable upper make the Daily Cruise a reliable choice for daily training. Great value for runners of all levels.
reviews: Good value shoe, nothing fancy.
Lasted me 800km which is impressive at this price.
A bit heavy but very comfortable.

pdp_text: Built for the mountains. A waterproof GORE-TEX membrane keeps water out while an aggressive 5mm lug outsole grips loose terrain. Reinforced toe cap protects against rock strikes. Take on any trail in any weather.
reviews: Grip is superb on wet rock.
Too hot for tropical running, my feet were swimming.
Heavy but bombproof.

pdp_text: Run lighter on the planet. The Loop is made with 72% recycled content including a recycled polyester upper and a bio-based foam midsole. Verda is a certified B Corp and every pair is carbon-offset. Sustainable never looked so good.
reviews: Love the ethics, ride is just okay.
Comfortable enough for 5-10km.
Nice that they publish the material breakdown.

pdp_text: Maximum cushioning for maximum comfort. A 38mm stack of AIRFOAM PLUS absorbs impact so you can run longer with less fatigue. Designed with a wider platform for stability. The ultimate long-run shoe.
reviews: Saved my knees on long runs.
Great for heavier runners, I'm 95kg and these hold up.
Too much shoe for anything fast.

pdp_text: For the runs that hurt. A firmer Swiftcell midsole and a lightweight mono-mesh upper make the Tempo our go-to for interval sessions and threshold work. 198g of pure intent.
bullet_specs: Exposed foam outsole in low-wear zones
reviews: Perfect for track sessions.
Upper is very thin, dries in an hour after a sweaty run.
Not enough cushioning for me over 15km.

pdp_text: A refreshing gel cleanser that removes excess oil without stripping. Formulated with 2% niacinamide and green tea extract for a clean, balanced finish. Fragrance-free and suitable for daily use. 150ml.
reviews: My skin feels clean but not tight.
Great in humid weather, cuts the shine.
Took about three weeks to see a difference in congestion.

pdp_text: A next-generation retinaldehyde serum in a soothing base of ceramides and squalane. Encapsulated for gradual release. Advanced technology for smoother, clearer skin over time. 30ml.
reviews: Gentle enough that I didn't peel.
Wish the instructions were clearer about how often to use it.
Works but you need patience.

pdp_text: A weightless SPF50+ PA++++ fluid that disappears into skin with no white cast. Water-resistant for 40 minutes. Suitable for all skin tones. 50ml.
reviews: Best sunscreen I've used in this climate, doesn't slide off.
Layers well under makeup.
Slight sting near the eyes.

pdp_text: A lightweight gel moisturiser in a refillable aluminium bottle. Hyaluronic acid and glycerin draw in moisture without heaviness. COSMOS Organic certified and packaged plastic-free. 50ml.
reviews: Perfect texture for humid weather.
Refills are a bit fiddly.
Not moisturising enough for my dry patches.
